limitations: A previous unfiltered WFS response was capped at 10,000 of 187,620 features and is deliberately excluded from staging.
The staged artifact is only the 586 records valid at its fixed query instant; it is not a real-time, complete, incident-perimeter, or provincial-agency-authoritative claim.
ESRI Shapefile field names are limited to ten characters; the service schema is retained above to make that source-format truncation explicit.
